prompt_text:
Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that lists or selects a voice for a target locale using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Option 2 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 3 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Option 4 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 5 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 6 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import elevenlabs
from elevenlabs import Voice, VoiceSettings, generate, play

def select_voice_for_locale(locale: str) -> Voice:
    """
    Selects or creates a voice suitable for a given locale using ElevenLabs.

    ElevenLabs does not directly map locales to voice IDs in a list API in the same way
    some other providers do. Instead, it allows for creating custom voices or selecting
    from a set of predefined voices and adjusting their settings.

    For this task, we will demonstrate selecting a predefined voice and, if necessary,
    showing how to adjust its settings or select a different one based on a hypothetical
    mapping for demonstration purposes.

    Args:
        locale: The target locale (e.g., "en-US", "fr-FR", "es-ES").

    Returns:
        A ElevenLabs Voice object configured for the locale.
    """
    elevenlabs.set_api_key("YOUR_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY") # Replace with your actual API key or use environment variable

    # ElevenLabs has a list of predefined voices. We'll pick one and demonstrate
    # how one might "select" a voice for a locale. In a real application,
    # you might have a more sophisticated mapping or use custom voices.
    # For simplicity, we'll choose a common English voice and modify settings
    # or select a different one based on the locale.

    # This is a hardcoded example. In a real application, you might use:
    # voices = elevenlabs.voices.get_all()
    # Then iterate to find a suitable voice.

    if locale.lower().startswith("en"):
        # Example: Using a specific predefined English voice by name or ID
        # ElevenLabs "Adam" is a common male English voice.
        # You can find voice IDs via elevenlabs.voices.get_all() or their API reference.
        voice_name_or_id = "Adam" # Or a specific voice ID like "pNInz6obpgDQGcFmaJgB"
        return Voice(
            voice_id=voice_name_or_id, # If voice_name_or_id is an ID
            # If voice_name_or_id is a name, ElevenLabs SDK often resolves it.
            settings=VoiceSettings(stability=0.75, similarity_boost=0.75, style=0.0, use_speaker_boost=True)
        )
    elif locale.lower().startswith("fr"):
        # Hypothetically, if ElevenLabs had a direct "French" voice ID or name
        # For demonstration, we'll use a generic voice and note the intent.
        # You would replace "Predefined French Voice ID" with an actual ElevenLabs French voice ID.
        print(f"Selecting a voice for French locale '{locale}'. Note: ElevenLabs requires specific voice IDs/names.")
        # As an example, let's pick a different default voice known to be flexible,
        # or you'd use a custom French voice.
        return Voice(
            voice_id="Bella", # Example: A different voice, assuming it could be configured for French well or is a custom French voice.
            settings=VoiceSettings(stability=0.7, similarity_boost=0.7, style=0.5, use_speaker_boost=True)
        )
    elif locale.lower().startswith("es"):
        print(f"Selecting a voice for Spanish locale '{locale}'. Note: ElevenLabs requires specific voice IDs/names.")
        return Voice(
            voice_id="Antoni", # Another example voice
            settings=VoiceSettings(stability=0.6, similarity_boost=0.6, style=0.3, use_speaker_boost=True)
        )
    else:
        # Default to a general-purpose English voice if locale is not explicitly handled
        print(f"Locale '{locale}' not specifically handled. Defaulting to a generic English voice.")
        return Voice(
            voice_id="Rachel",
            settings=VoiceSettings(stability=0.7, similarity_boost=0.7, style=0.0, use_speaker_boost=True)
        )
